purpose: The video_shape template for the `lyric-video` shape. Genres that declare video_shape: lyric-video (activist only, per music/genres.yaml) drive this shape. It is a TEMPLATE, not a release asset: see audio_bed below.
why_this_file_exists: Card t_ec378832. `music/genres.yaml` gave `activist` video_shape: lyric-video, and no template existed -- the registry validator never checked video_shape, so the registry named a shape no renderer owned. Rather than repoint activist at `single-4min`, this artifact was rendered, because `single_4min.mp4` is a static placeholder card (measured: 120 sampled frames, 2 distinct 64x64-gray signatures; its only text is the literal string 'Verse 1: Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet' under the heading 'Single-4min'). It is not a lyric video, so claiming it as one would have been false.

renderer.drive_from: a track's lyrics.suno.txt + section timing (--sections-file, or bars derived from --bpm and --duration)
renderer.interpreter: /usr/bin/python3 (3.14.7: numpy 2.5.3, PIL 12.3.0). The PATH python on this host lacks both.

source.lyric_sheet_note: Hash-bound and human-authored (provenance: human-original, j_kro). The renderer reads it and never writes it; the sha256 above matches music/lyrics/activist/what-runs-beneath/manifest.json, so the sheet is unchanged.
source.title: What Runs Beneath

section_timing.derivation: bars per section from the tag map scaled by largest-remainder to exactly 96 bars at 96 BPM (bar = 2.500s), i.e. exactly 240.0s
section_timing.note: The sheet repeats [Chorus]; both instances are kept as separate timed sections because the second starts later in time than the first.

style_conformance.accent: #c2542e (one accent colour per video, used sparingly: the insert hairline and the section label only)
style_conformance.medium_variation: the 4:3 archival insert is cut from a DIFFERENT medium than the wall it sits on and the medium changes per section (newsprint / chalk on pavement / protest wood / paper)
style_conformance.motion: slow zoom + handheld sway + integer-pixel gate weave + 5 occasional focus hunts (the blur is applied to the world layer only, never to the type)
style_conformance.type: Nimbus Mono PS (Courier clone, typewriter), lyrics appear ON the phrase with a per-character reveal, never after it
style_conformance.chorus_motif: each chorus line is additionally written by 7 staggered, rotated ghost hands -- the 'crowd of hands writing the same line' the spec asks for
style_conformance.grain_unit_interpretation: documentary-grain.md says 'Grain 6-8%' and NO file in this repo defines the unit (other styles give 2% 'the lightest of all visuals' up to 8-10%). Implemented as PROPORTIONAL modulation (6.5% of each pixel's own value). Measured: an additive field of 6.5% of FULL SCALE flattened the frame to 'no visible scene detail anywhere' and cost 5-7x the bitrate.
style_conformance.print_artifacts: static dirt specks + 3 hair scratches (fixed field, free to encode) and a 3% exposure flicker, added because a frame with grain but no print artifacts reads as a digital filter rather than 16mm
style_conformance.excluded_by_spec: no glossy kinetic type, no karaoke bounce, no drop shadow, no clickbait thumbnail framing

audio_bed.kind: 96 BPM reference click slate (downbeat accented), 48 kHz mono AAC
audio_bed.why: No activist master exists: the generate stage has not run. The shape must still ffprobe at its real duration with a real audio stream, so the bed gives the section timing an audible reference. It is NOT music and must be replaced with the track master before publishing.

measured.distinct_frame_signatures: 120 of 120 sampled at 2.0s cadence (64x64 gray). For contrast: single_4min.mp4 scores 2. This is a real edit, not a raw dump.

gates.resolution: gate: none -- no lane in this genre declares gate: gate_youtube_authentic (lanes: direct-fan, sync-documentary, streaming); when_absent: none, so the visual stage runs no gate for it
gates.why: activist publishes no video to a YouTube surface, so gate_youtube_authentic would check a lane the genre does not have. That decision lives in music/lanes.yaml `stage_gates:` (card t_d9983bb9) and is resolved from the genre's own lanes -- it is not hardcoded in the stage prompt.

regression_check.selftest: proves the check FAILS on the t_ec378832 incident (a declared video_shape with no artifact)
regression_check.catches: every genre's video_shape must resolve to music/visuals/<shape with '-' -> '_'>.mp4, except the deliberate 'none'. The file name is derived, not tabulated, so the check cannot drift.
